title: Three app states
slide_intent: Compare expressive and task-focused screens so brand character can coexist with clear steps and confirmation.
strategic_value: Xfinity can retain a familiar identity while shifting from a human benefit to gateway setup.
demonstration: Three phones on blue show a lifestyle-led WiFi Freely screen, a pale gateway-activation screen and a purple gateway-connected confirmation.
practical_value: Choose how much imagery and color a screen can carry by comparing the communication job of each state.

content_islands.name: Lifestyle state
content_islands.spec: Place the orange photographic phone at left with the short WiFi Freely message.

content_islands.name: Setup state
content_islands.spec: Center the pale screen with a gateway image and activation prompt.

content_islands.name: Confirmation state
content_islands.spec: Place the purple connected state at right with the status card below the product image.

reference_purposes.Expression: Orange photography, a restrained pale interface and a purple product field show the identity’s range.
reference_purposes.Application: The three screens apply the identity to attraction, activation and confirmation.
